about.title: About Me
about.text:
Bachelor in applied computer engineering (Bacc. ing. comp.)
Computer engineering graduate with a strong foundation in software development and an interest in embedded systems. Experienced in C++ and C#/.NET, and familiar with the fundamentals of digital electronics. During my internship, I worked with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, React, and Docker in an agile team (Scrum, Kanban).

items.desc: During the internship, I worked on web application development using modern development tools and processes:

Introduction to DevOps fundamentals (CI/CD, servers, deployment)
Working in an agile environment (Scrum, Kanban)
